# ffxf_database_backup (Resource)

Manages the backup feature of an FFXF Cloud database. Database features are in beta; accounts without access receive HTTP 403. Creating a manual backup is append-only; the API has no delete endpoint, so Terraform deletion only removes the resource from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_database_backup" "example" {
  database_id = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) Parent database ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for this managed database object.
